purpose: Illustration-only samples for layered-card prototype, not production deck replacements

prompts.court: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached existing woodcut playing-card sprite sheet. Produce the SAME three-column, one-row sheet with Jack, Queen, King illustrations in exactly their original order and edge-to-edge cell positions. Preserve the woodcut figures, mirrored double-headed composition, face identities, clothing, crowns, flowers, sword, central heart motifs, palette, paper texture, black borders, and large illustration scale. Remove ONLY the large J/Q/K corner letters and the small standalone heart suit index immediately beneath them from the top-left and inverted bottom-right of EACH card. Fill their former positions seamlessly with the same natural cream paper. These are illustration-only fronts for a game that draws its own UI text. No letters, digits, corner suit indices, badges, text boxes, new inner borders, or extra miniature cards. Keep the central decorative hearts on clothing and flowers. Do not shrink the art to add a header. Keep naturally quiet paper corners, not hard-edged blank patches. Output the complete three-card sheet at 1536 by 1024 pixels.
prompts.numbers: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference/edit target: existing woodcut hearts number-card sprite sheet. All ten cells have the same central floral-heart ornament; select the first cell as the visual source and output ONE standalone complete playing-card front at 9:14 portrait ratio (864 by 1344 pixels), not a sheet. Preserve its rich large red heart with cream leafy decoration, flowers, foliage, gold accents, cream paper grain, fine dark frame, and rounded outer corners. Remove the large A at top left, inverted A at bottom right, and the small standalone corner heart suit indices beneath them. Seamlessly continue the natural cream paper through those former index areas. Retain the LARGE CENTRAL ORNAMENTAL HEART and the full floral illustration at normal size. This is an art-only image; ranks and small suit indices will be drawn separately by the game. No text, letters, digits, badge, opaque label patch, header strip, or card-within-card. Keep the original naturally quiet top-left and bottom-right paper corners for later index text. Return exactly one clean illustration-only card face.
